mask.tooltip: Hint mask(s), white = subject. The mask of a cutout PNG from Load Image needs invert; a Mask Editor painting does not.

invert.tooltip: Swap subject and background. Turn on for the mask of a cutout PNG from Load Image (its MASK is 1 - alpha). Masks painted in the Mask Editor are already white = subject; leave this off.

threshold.tooltip: Make the mask binary: values at or above become 1, below become 0. 0 = off.

grow_px.tooltip: Grow (+) or shrink (-) the mask by this many pixels.

blur_px.tooltip: Soften the mask edges (Gaussian, sigma = blur_px / 2).

frame.tooltip: Use every mask, or a single one: the first, last, middle, or frame_index.

frame_index.tooltip: Mask used when frame is 'index' (negative counts from the end).

match_frames.tooltip: The clip to key: the mask is resized to its frames, and a single mask is repeated for every frame (a per-frame hint).

CorridorKey2HintPrep.name: CorridorKey2HintPrep
CorridorKey2HintPrep.description: Turns any mask into a CorridorKey alpha hint: pick frames, invert, threshold, grow or shrink, blur, and match the clip's size and length.
